newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange trade extremely thin.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange trade extremely thin.

text.p: Trade was very quiet on the Istanbul gold exchange on Friday on low physical demand and as traders diverted funds to the bond market ahead of the five-day public sector holiday, dealers said.
Volume plunged to just 87 kilos from 533 on Thursday, with no deals in dollar terms.
Gold prices rose in lira terms to 1,283,600 lira per gram, from a previous 1,275,750 as the lira eased against the dollar.
The Turkish currency closed at 107,450 lira to the dollar, from 107,150 on Thursday.
Extra public holidays were announced on Thursday by the government for the two days before the traditional January 1 new year break.
The gold exchange will be open on Monday and Tuesday.
Turnover was 10 kilos in the morning session and 77 in the afternoon.
